scope: Frozen training-only standalone-source endpoint diagnostic using unprompted independent phoneme CTC. No playback, wake scores, relabelling or acceptance.

phoneme_model_identity.use: Independent phoneme consistency diagnostic only; no wake model acceptance

selection: All positive sources in the previously frozen384-source training audit whose same-path original text aliases all match the standalone Hey Nyx/Nix/Nicks spelling rule. Preserve command sources separately; select none from wake or phoneme scores.

readout.decoder: Unprompted greedy CTC; collapse repeats before removing blanks; preserve every nonblank token and its full consecutive frame run. No lexicon or expected-text conditioning.
readout.frame_support: For frame i, local convolution input support is [i*320,i*320+400), clipped to original sample count. The transformer has full utterance context; this is not the entire receptive field or a phonetic truth boundary.
readout.energy: Unchanged10ms RMS rule with threshold max(peak_RMS*.01,1), capped to original source length.
readout.summary: Per-engine original marker minus last CTC feature-support end and original marker minus RMS end:5/50/95quantiles, counts >200ms and >500ms, plus all-blank and final-token counts. No source is dropped because of recognition text or confidence.
readout.policy: Do not adopt CTC or RMS endpoints as replacement labels, change thresholds, inspect held-out audio or infer wake accuracy from this audit.
